cv_sections.summary:
Over the past 7+ years, I’ve crafted immersive gameplay, built
scalable multiplayer systems, and led development on games and
XR simulations that have reached millions — from IGDC award-
winning titles to high-stakes defense projects.
Whether it’s a dogfight in Fighter Pilot: Heavyfire or a real-time
inspection simulation for the Indian Air Force, I thrive at the
intersection of gameplay, engineering, and user experience.
What I bring:
• Deep command of Unity and C#, with a strong foundation in
systems architecture
• Hands-on expertise with Photon Fusion, PUN2, PlayFab, XR
Interaction Toolkit (XRI), and VRIF
• Cross-platform delivery experience — Mobile, WebGL, Meta Quest
(2 & 3), Hololens, PC
• Game Meta System design — skill trees, progression, inventory,
reward economy
• Custom Unity Editor tooling for designers and rapid iteration
• Monetization systems — IAPs, Unity Ads, Google Ads, mediation
strategies
• End-to-end development ownership — from prototyping to live ops
• Mentoring junior devs, setting coding standards, and managing
Agile sprints
What drives me:
I love building things that feel good to play and function beautifully
under the hood. From tight gameplay loops to persistent multiplayer
states, I believe great experiences are born from strong systems.
I’m always looking to collaborate on ambitious projects that push
technical boundaries while staying player-first.
  Page 1 of 5
   
If you’re building something that demands both heart and code —
let’s connect.

As a freelance Unity developer, I’ve worked with international clients across
industries like gaming and healthcare to deliver high-quality AR/VR and
interactive 3D applications.
Developed and deployed Unity applications for platforms including WebGL and
VR (Meta Quest 2 & 3).
Delivered MVPs and full projects with features like hand tracking, multiplayer

Integrated RESTful APIs to fetch and post real-time data, enabling dynamic in-
app experiences.
Closely collaborated with backend teams to define API contracts, troubleshoot
issues, and ensure seamless client-server communication.
Worked with global teams—designers, artists, and stakeholders—across time
zones using Agile workflows.
Provided technical consulting on architecture, SDK/tool selection, and
performance optimization.
Managed end-to-end development: from requirement gathering to final
deployment and post-launch updates.

powered by Convai.
